posts.title: They’re Made out of Meat
posts.description: “They’re made out of meat.” “Meat?” “Meat. They’re made out of meat.” “Meat?” “There’s no doubt about it. We picked several from different parts of the planet, took them aboard our recon vessels, probed them all the way through. They’re completely meat.” They’re Made out of Meat , Terry Bisson, 1991
